sentences.english: The clock on the wall is slow.
sentences.chinese: 墙上的钟慢了。

sentences.english: I kept looking at the clock during the boring meeting.
sentences.chinese: 在那个无聊的会议上我不停地看时钟。

sentences.english: My grandmother's old grandfather clock chimes every hour, and the sound reminds me of spending summers at her house.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶的老式落地钟每小时都敲响，那声音让我想起在她家度过的夏天。

sentences.english: I water my plant every day.
sentences.chinese: 我每天给我的植物浇水。

sentences.english: She has a beautiful plant on her desk that brightens up the whole room.
sentences.chinese: 她桌上有一盆漂亮的植物，让整个房间都明亮起来。

sentences.english: I tried to grow a tomato plant on my balcony last summer, but the squirrels kept digging it up before it could produce any fruit.
sentences.chinese: 去年夏天我试图在阳台上种一棵番茄，但松鼠总是在它结果之前把它挖出来。

sentences.english: Can you open this bottle for me?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我打开这个瓶子吗？

sentences.english: I always carry a reusable bottle to avoid buying plastic ones.
sentences.chinese: 我总是带一个可重复使用的瓶子，以免买塑料瓶。

sentences.english: I found an old message in a bottle on the beach, and even though it was faded and hard to read, it felt like discovering treasure.
sentences.chinese: 我在沙滩上发现了一个漂流瓶里的旧纸条，虽然字迹模糊难以辨认，但感觉就像发现了宝藏。

sentences.english: Don't forget your water bottle.
sentences.chinese: 别忘了你的水瓶。

sentences.english: My water bottle is made of stainless steel and keeps drinks cold for hours.
sentences.chinese: 我的水瓶是不锈钢做的，能保冷好几个小时。

sentences.english: During the hike, I realized I had left my water bottle in the car, so I had to share my friend's and felt terrible about it.
sentences.chinese: 徒步时我意识到把水瓶落在车里了，只好和朋友分享他的，感觉很不好意思。

sentences.english: I ride my bike to school.
sentences.chinese: 我骑自行车上学。

sentences.english: My dad taught me how to ride a bike without training wheels in one afternoon.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸用一个下午就教会了我不用辅助轮骑自行车。

sentences.english: I bought a second-hand bike for cheap, fixed it up with some new tires and paint, and now it's my favorite way to get around town.
sentences.chinese: 我便宜买了一辆二手自行车，换了新轮胎、重新喷了漆，现在它是我在城里出行的最爱方式。

sentences.english: Let's take a photo together.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起照张相吧。

sentences.english: I have a photo of my family on my desk to remind me of home.
sentences.chinese: 我桌上放着一张全家福，提醒我想家。

sentences.english: While cleaning the attic, I found a photo of my parents on their first date, and they looked so young and happy.
sentences.chinese: 清理阁楼时，我找到一张父母第一次约会时的照片，他们看起来那么年轻、幸福。

sentences.english: Please stand in the front.
sentences.chinese: 请站到前面来。

sentences.english: There's a beautiful garden in front of the house.
sentences.chinese: 房子前面有一个美丽的花园。

sentences.english: I was sitting in the front row of the concert, and when the singer reached out to touch my hand, I almost fainted.
sentences.chinese: 我坐在音乐会的前排，当歌手伸手来碰我的手时，我差点晕过去。

sentences.english: Don't park in front of the gate.
sentences.chinese: 别在门前停车。

sentences.english: The kids are playing in front of the school, waiting for their parents.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们在学校前面玩耍，等着家长来接。

sentences.english: I had to give a speech in front of the whole class, and my hands were shaking so badly that I could barely hold the paper.
sentences.chinese: 我必须在全班面前演讲，我的手抖得厉害，几乎拿不住稿纸。

sentences.english: The secret is between you and me.
sentences.chinese: 这个秘密只有你我知道。

sentences.english: I sat between my mom and dad at the dinner table.
sentences.chinese: 晚餐时我坐在妈妈和爸爸中间。

sentences.english: There's a narrow path between the two houses that leads to a hidden garden, and we used to play there as kids.
sentences.chinese: 两栋房子之间有一条狭窄的小路通向一个隐蔽的花园，我们小时候常在那里玩。

sentences.english: The birds are flying above us.
sentences.chinese: 鸟儿在我们头顶飞。

sentences.english: The clock above the fireplace is an antique from my great-grandmother.
sentences.chinese: 壁炉上方的钟是我曾祖母传下来的古董。

sentences.english: We heard a strange noise coming from the apartment above us at midnight, like someone was moving heavy furniture around.
sentences.chinese: 半夜我们听到楼上公寓传来奇怪的声音，好像有人在搬重家具。

sentences.english: Come sit beside me.
sentences.chinese: 过来坐我旁边。

sentences.english: There's a lovely little coffee shop beside the bookstore downtown.
sentences.chinese: 市中心书店旁边有一家可爱的小咖啡店。

sentences.english: During the long flight, I was lucky to have an empty seat beside me, so I could stretch out and get some sleep.
sentences.chinese: 长途飞行中，我旁边幸运地有个空位，所以我能伸展开来睡一会儿。

sentences.english: The cat is hiding behind the sofa.
sentences.chinese: 猫躲在沙发后面。

sentences.english: Someone left a surprise gift behind the door for my birthday.
sentences.chinese: 有人把一份惊喜礼物放在门后给我过生日。

sentences.english: I felt someone tap me on the shoulder, but when I turned around, there was nobody there; later I found out my brother was hiding behind the curtain.
sentences.chinese: 我感觉有人拍我肩膀，但转过身却没看到人，后来发现我弟弟躲在窗帘后面。

sentences.english: I'll be there in a minute.
sentences.chinese: 我马上就到。

sentences.english: There's a fantastic taco truck over there that we need to try.
sentences.chinese: 那边有一辆很棒的墨西哥卷饼卡车，我们得去尝尝。

sentences.english: When we finally got there after a twelve-hour drive, the cabin was even more beautiful than in the pictures, and the view took my breath away.
sentences.chinese: 我们开了十二个小时车终于到了那里，小木屋比照片上还美，景色让我屏住了呼吸。

sentences.english: My grandparents live in the countryside.
sentences.chinese: 我的爷爷奶奶住在乡下。

sentences.english: Every summer, I visit my grandparents and help them in the garden.
sentences.chinese: 每年夏天，我都去看望祖父母并帮他们料理花园。

sentences.english: My grandmother tells the best stories about what life was like when she was young, and I could listen to her for hours.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶最会讲她年轻时候生活是什么样的，我听她讲几个小时都不腻。

sentences.english: That's their new house.
sentences.chinese: 那是他们的新房子。

sentences.english: The children left their toys all over the floor again.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们又把玩具扔得满地都是。

sentences.english: My neighbors are so kind; their garden is always full of flowers, and they share fresh vegetables with the whole street.
sentences.chinese: 我的邻居非常和善，他们的花园总是开满鲜花，而且他们会和整条街分享新鲜蔬菜。

sentences.english: I love your house!
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢你的房子！

sentences.english: We're painting the house this weekend, so it looks brand new.
sentences.chinese: 这个周末我们粉刷房子，让它看起来焕然一新。

sentences.english: When we bought this old house, it was falling apart, but after two years of hard work, it finally feels like home.
sentences.chinese: 我们买下这栋老房子时它都快散架了，但经过两年的努力，终于有了家的感觉。

sentences.english: The parking lot is full.
sentences.chinese: 停车场满了。

sentences.english: We need a lot of volunteers for the event.
sentences.chinese: 这个活动我们需要很多志愿者。

sentences.english: The empty lot next door is finally being turned into a community garden.
sentences.chinese: 隔壁的空地终于要被改造成社区花园了。

sentences.english: I have lots of homework tonight.
sentences.chinese: 我今晚有很多作业。

sentences.english: There were lots of people at the festival, but the atmosphere was great.
sentences.chinese: 节日活动上人山人海，但气氛很棒。

sentences.english: We planted lots of flowers in the backyard, and now it's full of butterflies and bees, which makes me really happy.
sentences.chinese: 我们在后院种了很多花，现在那里满是蝴蝶和蜜蜂，这让我很开心。

sentences.english: I picked a flower for you.
sentences.chinese: 我为你摘了一朵花。

sentences.english: She received a beautiful bouquet of flowers on her birthday.
sentences.chinese: 她生日时收到了一束漂亮的鲜花。

sentences.english: Every spring, the flowers in the park bloom and turn the whole area into a colorful wonderland.
sentences.chinese: 每年春天，公园里的花盛开，把整个地方变成了五彩缤纷的仙境。

sentences.english: Help me move this table.
sentences.chinese: 帮我挪一下这张桌子。

sentences.english: We're going to move to a new apartment next month.
sentences.chinese: 下个月我们要搬去新公寓了。

sentences.english: The movie's ending was so touching that it moved me to tears, and I couldn't stop thinking about it for days.
sentences.chinese: 电影的结尾太感人了，我感动得流泪，之后好几天都无法停止回想。

sentences.english: Your hands are dirty. Go wash them.
sentences.chinese: 你的手脏了，去洗洗。

sentences.english: After playing soccer in the rain, our clothes were so dirty that my mom sighed.
sentences.chinese: 在雨中踢完足球，我们的衣服脏透了，妈妈叹了口气。

sentences.english: I left my white sneakers outside, and after the storm they were so dirty that I had to throw them in the washing machine twice.
sentences.chinese: 我把白球鞋放在了外面，暴风雨后它们脏得不行，我不得不用洗衣机洗了两遍。

sentences.english: I looked for you everywhere.
sentences.chinese: 我到处找你。

sentences.english: There are toys everywhere in the living room because the kids were playing.
sentences.chinese: 客厅里到处都是玩具，因为孩子们在玩。

sentences.english: During cherry blossom season, the streets are covered in pink petals, and it looks like a scene from a fairy tale everywhere you go.
sentences.chinese: 樱花季时，街道上铺满了粉色花瓣，不管你走到哪里都像童话里的场景。

sentences.english: I saw a mouse in the kitchen!
sentences.chinese: 我在厨房看到一只老鼠！

sentences.english: My computer mouse stopped working, so I have to use the trackpad.
sentences.chinese: 我的鼠标坏了，只好用触摸板。

sentences.english: We tried to catch the mouse humanely with a trap and released it in the field far from our house.
sentences.chinese: 我们试着用人道的捕鼠笼捉住了老鼠，并把它放生到了离家很远的田野里。

sentences.english: Where do you live?
sentences.chinese: 你住在哪里？

sentences.english: I've been living in this city for five years and I love it.
sentences.chinese: 我在这座城市住了五年了，我很喜欢它。

sentences.english: I want to live in a small town by the sea when I retire, where I can hear the waves every morning.
sentences.chinese: 我退休后想住在海边的小镇，每天早上都能听到海浪声。

sentences.english: I love spending time in nature.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢待在大自然里。

sentences.english: Hiking in nature is a great way to clear your mind and reduce stress.
sentences.chinese: 在大自然中徒步是理清思绪、减压的好方法。

sentences.english: It's in her nature to help others; she's the first person to volunteer whenever someone needs assistance.
sentences.chinese: 帮助他人是她的天性，每当有人需要帮助时，她总是第一个站出来。
